name: Systemic and Relational Risks
definition: A decision table for assessing the systemic and relational risks of AI models in the context of Agentic AI Risk Score (AARS)

x_org.owasp#aivss:DYNID:0.1.0.name: Dynamic Identity
x_org.owasp#aivss:DYNID:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the Dynamic Identity capabilities of an agentic AI System.

values.name: None/Not Present
values.definition: Predefined identities per agent or tool, granular least-permissions scopes, hard-coded access

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Human-in-the-loop identity delegation, deterministic assignment of permissions with policy engine

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: No access limitations to dynamic identities, agentic individual permission/scope selection

x_org.owasp#aivss:MAI:0.1.0.name: Multi-Agent Interactions
x_org.owasp#aivss:MAI:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the Multi-Agent Interactions capabilities of an agentic AI System.

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Limited selection of agent interactions, predefined multi-agent coordination

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: No limitations on agent interactions, dynamic, agent-guided multi-agent coordination

basic:LMH:1.0.0.name: LowMediumHigh
basic:LMH:1.0.0.definition: A Low/Medium/High decision point / outcome group.
